item.title: Anthropic Created a Honeypot to Lure AI Agents Into Misbehaving
item.description: A new test assumes AI agents can go rogue—and asks whether they can resist temptation.

item.title: Don’t Bring Up AI if You Want to Enjoy Your Thanksgiving
item.description: Young people anxious about their futures say they’re increasingly frustrated with their pro-AI parents. They’re worried it’s going to make holiday gatherings very tense.

item.title: AI Solved Math’s Most Famous Problem. Now Humans Are Struggling to Understand It
item.description: It will take mathematicians months to understand the “alien” 17-million-line solution an Anthropic researcher produced for the Riemann hypothesis.

item.title: Jensen Huang Is Back, and So Is Nvidia’s Stock
item.description: Jensen Huang comes back, numbers go up. Maybe the reason behind the CEO’s return is just that simple?

item.title: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO
item.description: The company’s board of directors has reinstated Huang a little more than a week after the CEO resigned amid allegations of multiple affairs, including with a direct report.

item.title: Nvidia Is Powering Brain-Computer Interfaces Now
item.description: Brain-computer interface company Paradromics is using Nvidia’s computing hardware and software to process brain data.

item.title: Submit Your Questions: Will Anyone Keep You Safe From AI?
item.description: Experts agree that AI, in one way or another, poses real danger. Will the industry do anything about it? Join our livestream on December 2 to hear your questions answered.

item.title: States Sue SpaceX Over Grok Deepfakes
item.description: The attorneys general of Oregon and Virginia are suing several of Elon Musk’s companies, alleging they implemented weak safeguards against sexualized imagery of real people, including children.

item.title: Goodbye, World: The End of Programmers
item.description: The last thing you should ever read—and the last thing I may ever write—about the craft of coding.

item.title: Banks Have Had It Up to Here With Your AI Agent
item.description: Major US financial institutions are banning third-party bots from logging into your accounts—and warning that any costly bot mistakes are strictly your problem.
